decisions.reason: The accepted Apollo transfer path does not specify or change which LinkedIn URL type is stored in the CRM.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing automatic Apollo enrichment with email information; the overall HubSpot arrival time belongs to the transfer-path Requirement.
Changing the ingestion path through Apollo does not alter HubSpot list creation or lead-category management.
The accepted workflow does not resolve whether duplicate status appears on LinkedIn before export or through a CRM alert after export.
The transfer-path decision does not change visibility of email or LinkedIn chat history in HubSpot lead records.
Routing leads through Apollo does not change HubSpot classification mechanisms such as properties, tags, stages, or categories.
The source decision does not modify the inclusion or behavior of lead notes in HubSpot.
The accepted Sales Navigator-to-Apollo-to-HubSpot path does not change HubSpot lead-nurturing workflows.
The transfer-path modification does not alter the HubSpot task-assignment system.
This task-local deliverable maps MeetAlfred-to-HubSpot flow, while the source decision concerns Sales Navigator-to-Apollo-to-HubSpot ingestion.
The source changes inbound lead transfer to HubSpot and neither resumes nor changes the deferred outbound HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization.
Using Apollo in the accepted transfer path does not change the existing Apollo account-configuration requirement or its stated setup status.
